map.根据约束类型和约束开始时间，计算松解时间点和约束总时长，生成完整松解计划。: From restraint type and start time, computes release times and total duration, generating a full release plan.

map.手腕约束每2小时松解一次，每次松解15分钟: Wrist restraint: release every 2 h for 15 min

map.约束手套：每2小时松解1次，观察末梢血运: Mitt: release every 2 h, watch distal perfusion
map.胸衣约束：每2小时松解1次，每次松解15分钟: Vest: release every 2 h, 15 min each
map.连续约束不超过24小时，需评估是否继续约束: Continuous restraint <=24 h; assess whether to continue
map.评估局部皮肤、关节活动度、末梢血运（温度、颜色、毛细血管充盈）；记录约束部位皮肤: Assess local skin, joint mobility, distal perfusion (temp, color, cap refill); record site skin status.
map.注意：使用约束带前需取得医嘱和家属知情同意。约束期间密切观察，定时松解并记录。约: Note: obtain order and family consent before restraint. Observe closely, release on schedule and record. Restraint is not routine care; remove as early as possible.
